channel.title: RemadeByAI: new apps
channel.description: The newest AI-built apps listed on RemadeByAI: familiar software, rebuilt with AI.

item.title: Aurora Courier: Inspired by endless flying games
item.description: Carry glowing lanterns across the northern sky; every gold ring you fly through turns the whole world into one of 473 art styles. (Web · Free · MIT)

item.title: Abyssal Garden: Inspired by underwater exploration games
item.description: Swim through a dreamy underwater world of kelp forests, sunbeams, a sunken ship and manta rays, all in one 96 KB HTML file. (Web · Free · MIT)

item.title: Shanhe: Inspired by turn-based 4X strategy games
item.description: A turn-based 4X strategy game on the real terrain of East Asia, with fifty fictional nations and xiangqi-style pieces on a sand-table map. (Web · Free · MIT)

item.title: Per My Last Email: Inspired by choice-driven story card games
item.description: A satirical office survival game: get through 12 weeks under a workplace bully, keep receipts and decide whether to speak up. (Web · Free · No licence stated)

item.title: Summer Festival: Inspired by cozy slice-of-life games
item.description: Walk an anime-style seaside town on the night of its summer festival: scoop a goldfish, win the ring toss and stay for the fireworks. (Web · Free · MIT)

item.title: PaletteRider: Inspired by calm exploration games
item.description: Ride a bicycle through famous paintings turned into small 3D towns, from Klee's Castle and Sun to Van Gogh's Café Terrace at Night. (Web · Free · No licence stated)

item.title: Clanker Racing: Inspired by 1990s off-road arcade racers
item.description: A chunky retro off-road racer in the browser: beat five rivals on about two dozen silly tracks, from a dirt canyon to Mars. (Web · Free · MIT)

item.title: Tumblebuds: Inspired by guide-the-crowd puzzle games
item.description: A small 3D puzzle game for phones and computers: give a sleepy marching crew the skills to find its way home through Honeydew Hollow. (Web, iOS, Android · Free · All rights reserved)

item.title: Wisp Player: Alternative to foobar2000 and MusicBee
item.description: A featherweight gapless music player for local files on Windows, using about 10 MB of RAM, with synced lyrics and 35 themes. (Windows · Free · GPL-3.0)

item.title: Lucrometro: Alternative to justETF and broker watchlist apps
item.description: A small Android app to check a short list of ETFs and Borsa Italiana stocks a few times a day, with no account and no server. (Android · Free · AGPL-3.0)

item.title: BannedBrowser: Alternative to Chrome-engine browsers (an engine written from scratch)
item.description: A web browser built from scratch in Rust with its own layout and JavaScript engine, good today for simple and old-web sites. (Windows, macOS, Linux · Free · MIT or Apache-2.0)

item.title: Hylly: Alternative to Calibre-Web and Kavita for books you bought
item.description: A home library for the DRM-free e-books, comics and RPG books you own: it downloads them from the shops, keeps them safe and serves them to your reading apps. (Windows, macOS, Linux · Free · AGPL-3.0)

item.title: trymesh: Alternative to Autodesk Fusion (proof of concept)
item.description: A proof-of-concept parametric 3D CAD editor in the browser, with constraint-solved sketches, an editable feature timeline and an MCP server so an AI can model too. (Web · Free · MIT)

item.title: Free Physical Modeling Synth: Alternative to Pianoteq and other physical-modeling instruments
item.description: Physically modelled piano, strings, winds, mallets and drums that run in the browser with no samples, and play MIDI files too. (Web · Free · MIT)

item.title: Jewelcase: Alternative to iTunes-style syncing for Android gaming handhelds
item.description: A Linux desktop app that manages an Android retro handheld the way iTunes managed an iPod: tick the games that belong on it and press Sync. (Linux · Free · GPL-3.0)

item.title: Taskbar Timer: Alternative to the Windows Clock app timers
item.description: Countdown timers for Windows 11 that sit right on the taskbar as small live pills, with Pomodoro, count-to-a-time and repeating alarms. (Windows · Free · MIT)

item.title: PDF4Free: Alternative to Adobe Acrobat Pro
item.description: A free Windows PDF viewer and editor modelled on Acrobat Pro's tool set: edit, comment, organise, convert, OCR, fill and design forms, redact and sign. (Windows · Free · MIT)

item.title: Pelican Ride: Inspired by endless runner games
item.description: An endless 3D runner: a helmeted pelican on a vintage bike chases fish along the coast, hits ramps and pulls air tricks. (Web · Free · MIT)

item.title: BLAMELESS: Inspired by arena shooters
item.description: An on-call shooter: at 03:07 the pager goes off, prod is down, and you go into production in person to kill what is crashing it. (Web · Free · MIT)

item.title: Atlantis: Inspired by flying and exploration games
item.description: Fly through a garden city of white marble, crystal and turquoise canals at golden hour, all made in code in one HTML file. (Web · Free · MIT)

item.title: WHITEOUT: Inspired by first-person survival horror games
item.description: A first-person survival horror game at a snowbound polar station: restart three generators and call for rescue while something stalks you. (Web · Free · MIT)

item.title: Graveyard Shift: Inspired by round-based zombie survival modes
item.description: A round-based zombies shooter at a roadside diner: board up windows, buy weapons off the wall and hold out through the night. (Web · Free · MIT)

item.title: Cayley: Alternative to desktop flight simulators, in a browser tab
item.description: A browser flight simulator with real wing and propeller physics, nine real aircraft, live weather and the whole planet in 3D. (Web · Free · MIT)

item.title: Tiny Planet: Inspired by small-world exploration games
item.description: A tiny round world to walk and fly around: sea, beaches, a pine forest, a village, a lighthouse and a windmill, always at sunset on one side. (Web · Free · MIT)

item.title: Valley Ride: Inspired by calm riding and walking games
item.description: A calm horse ride up a mountain valley to a campfire at sunset, with no score, no enemy and no way to fail. (Web · Free · MIT)

item.title: Ironvale: Inspired by classic real-time strategy games
item.description: An original 3D real-time strategy game: gather, build, advance through three ages and defeat the Crimson March, in a story campaign or skirmish. (Web, Windows · Free · No licence (source visible))

item.title: YAME: Alternative to Mp3tag (for Mac)
item.description: A small Mac app for editing MP3 tags and cover art, made for music on a USB stick in the car. (macOS · Free · MIT)

item.title: Game Launcher for macOS: Alternative to Playnite (for Mac)
item.description: One Mac app for all your games: native apps, Steam and Windows games in CrossOver, each launched the right way. (macOS · Free · MIT)

item.title: Haze: Alternative to BOSS Tone Studio (for the KATANA MkII)
item.description: A tone editor, librarian and practice rig for the BOSS KATANA MkII guitar amp on Linux and Windows. (Linux, Windows · Free · MIT)

item.title: FewChat: Alternative to Manychat (for Instagram)
item.description: Self-hosted Instagram DM automation: comment-to-DM, story replies, a visual flow builder, a live inbox and metrics, on your own Cloudflare account. (Web · Free (needs Cloudflare Workers Paid, $5 a month) · MIT)

item.title: Focus: Alternative to Toggl Track and Timing
item.description: A calm, local time tracker for macOS that puts the time you log next to what was actually on your screen. (macOS · Free · No licence (source visible))

item.title: Kiln: Alternative to Figma and Framer
item.description: A design canvas made of real HTML and CSS: draw with real flexbox, fonts and effects, then export the same code. (macOS, Windows, Linux, Web · Free · MIT)

item.title: No Sleep: Alternative to Amphetamine and Caffeine
item.description: A tiny Mac menu bar app that keeps your Mac awake, lid closed included, with timers and safety cut-outs. (macOS · Free · MIT)

item.title: HukukFix Download Manager: Alternative to Internet Download Manager
item.description: A free Windows download manager with a Chrome extension: up to 32 connections per file, reliable pause and resume, and video capture. (Windows · Free · MIT)

item.title: HFix Windows 11 Tools: Alternative to CCleaner and Windows debloat scripts
item.description: A free Windows 11 tune-up and debloat tool: turn off telemetry and ads, clean RAM and disk, and watch processes and network use. (Windows · Free · MIT)

item.title: Monido: Alternative to Kubera and net-worth spreadsheets
item.description: A self-hosted net-worth and cash-flow tracker for one person or a whole family, entered by hand with no bank connections. (Linux, macOS, Web · Free · MIT)

item.title: Aevum: Inspired by classic age-advancing real-time strategy games
item.description: An original 3D real-time strategy game in the browser: build a village and lead it through five ages, from the Stone Age to the Industrial Age. (Web · Free · AGPL-3.0)

item.title: Imperios 1800–2100: Inspired by classic age-advancing real-time strategy games
item.description: A real-time strategy game through five ages from 1800 to 2100, from steam to synthesis, with every texture, model and tune generated in code. (Web · Free · MIT)

item.title: Frontier Command: Inspired by base-building real-time strategy games
item.description: A stylized 3D real-time strategy game: harvest, build a base, train an army and fight across river maps, on desktop, phone or tablet. (Web · Free · All rights reserved (free to play, source visible))

item.title: Wild Fields 1648: Inspired by historical real-time strategy games
item.description: A real-time strategy game on the Ukrainian steppe in 1648: raise a Cossack town, farm, gather, train an army and beat the AI. (Web · Free · MIT)

item.title: Bee Garden: Inspired by cozy nature games
item.description: A first-person watercolor meadow game: forage as a honeybee for five summers and shape the meadow you come back to. (Web · Free · MIT)

item.title: Last Beacon: Inspired by tower defense games
item.description: A 3D island tower defense where every turret needs power: wire your defenses to the lighthouse and hold off ten waves from the sea. (Web · Free · MIT)

item.title: Casa de Gemas: Inspired by cozy hidden-object games
item.description: A tiny watercolor garden to explore: water the plants, shake the branches and find each season's hidden gems with Oli the owl. (Web · Free · MIT)

item.title: DRIFTWING: Inspired by relaxing flight games
item.description: A calm flying game over an endless world made up as you go, with an AI copilot called WREN along for the ride. (Web · Free · No licence (source visible))

item.title: Forja Abisal: Inspired by 1990s first-person shooters
item.description: A retro 90s-style first-person shooter for the browser, with maze-like foundry levels, keys, secrets and an automap. (Web · Free · MIT)

item.title: Tater's Flight Sim: Inspired by desktop flight simulators
item.description: A flight simulator for the browser: fly a Cessna, an F-16, an A-10 or a 747 with real flight physics over farmland, coast and mountains. (Web · Free · MIT)

item.title: Tempora: Inspired by life simulator games
item.description: A life simulator spanning twelve thousand years: be born anywhere from 10,000 BC to the far future and live it one year at a time. (Web · Free · MIT)

item.title: LUMENRIFT: Inspired by tower defense games
item.description: A tower defense game: wall off and burn back waves of shadows to keep the last light burning through thirty nights. (Web · Free · CC0 1.0)

item.title: KAIJU DOKAN!: Inspired by giant-monster destruction games
item.description: Stomp, punch and breathe magma as a giant kaiju and wreck a sunset harbour city, floor by floor, before time runs out. (Web · Free · MIT)

item.title: NOVA LANCER: Inspired by 3D rail shooters
item.description: A three-minute 3D rail shooter over a sunset sea, a red-rock canyon and a neon fortress city, ending with a sea-dragon boss. (Web · Free · MIT)
